bibliographic.title: Werner's Quest
bibliographic.author: Jan Åberg
bibliographic.description:
This is a series of four games, called Werner's Quest. The games are parodies of Zork 1, 2, 3 and Enchanter respectively.

1. The Black Ladder
2. Revenge of the Thing-Fish
3. Rance the Dungeonkeeper
4. Unchanter
